extension.name: Applied Epistemic Engineering
extension.description: Challenges claims, traces evidence, propagates uncertainty, and routes epistemic failures between Spec Kit phases.
extension.author: ElectroHire

commands.name: speckit.aee.assess
commands.description: Assess explicit claims and emit both a rich AEE assessment and an Evaluator Contract result

commands.name: speckit.aee.challenge
commands.description: Adversarially challenge atomicity, boundaries, falsifiability, dependencies, and evidence independence

commands.name: speckit.aee.trace
commands.description: Render the claim dependency graph and inspect epistemic provenance

commands.name: speckit.aee.verify
commands.description: Verify the tamper-evident AEE ledger without claiming that its contents are true

commands.name: speckit.aee.gate
commands.description: Apply a CI-friendly decision gate to an AEE assessment

commands.name: speckit.aee.gaps
commands.description: Generate or update the gap register from a verification matrix and test evidence

hooks.prompt: Run an epistemic assessment of the specification?
hooks.description: Challenge requirements, assumptions, boundaries, and evidence after specification

hooks.prompt: Run an epistemic assessment of the plan?
hooks.description: Challenge plan claims, decisions, dependencies, and supporting evidence

hooks.prompt: Run an epistemic assessment of the task breakdown?
hooks.description: Challenge task traceability and the evidence required to verify completion

hooks.prompt: Run an epistemic assessment of the implementation?
hooks.description: Compare implementation claims with independently inspectable evidence

hooks.prompt: Regenerate the gap register from verification evidence?
hooks.description: Cross-reference the verification matrix against test evidence and update GAPS.md

config.name: aee-config.yml
config.description: AEE thresholds, ledger behavior, and lifecycle settings
